374	        repository = _repository_root(event.cwd)
375	        self.store.purge_expired()
376	        with self.store.locked(event.session_id, event.client):
377	            if event.kind is HookEventKind.SESSION_ENDED:
378	                self.store.delete(event.session_id, event.client)
379	                return HookOutcome()

381	            session = self.store.load(event.session_id, event.client) or self.store.new(
382	                event.session_id, repository, event.client
383	            )
384	            if event.event_id is not None:
385	                fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(event.model_dump_json().encode()).hexdigest()
386	                for cached in session.replayed_outcomes:
387	                    if cached["event_id"] == event.event_id:
388	                        if cached["fingerprint"] != fingerprint:
389	                            raise HookError("event_id was reused with different input")
390	                        return HookOutcome.model_validate(cached["outcome"])
391	            session.repository = str(repository)
392	            session.event_count += 1
393	            session.recent_events.append(_event_record(event, self.config.output_limit))
394	            session.recent_events = session.recent_events[-self.config.event_history_limit :]
395	
396	            if event.kind is HookEventKind.SESSION_STARTED:
397	                session.touch(self.store.ttl_seconds)

399	                return HookOutcome()
400	            if event.kind is HookEventKind.WORK_SUBMITTED:
401	                try:
402	                    if event.work_id is not None and event.work_id == session.work_id:
403	                        if session.work_prompt != event.prompt.strip():
404	                            raise HookError("work_id was reused with a different prompt")
405	                        if session.state is not None and (
406	                            session.state.active_extension_ids != list(self.active_extension_ids)
407	                            or session.state.extension_snapshot_revisions
408	                            != self.extension_snapshot_revisions
409	                        ):
410	                            raise HookError("extension snapshots changed; submit new work")

412	                            action=HookAction.INJECT_CONTEXT,

633	    def _directive_output(
634	        self,
635	        event: HookEvent,
636	        directive: Intervention,
637	        state: FactoryState,
638	        worker: WorkerRecord,
639	    ) -> HookOutcome:
640	        action = directive.action
641	        reason = directive.reason
642	        if action is InterventionType.STEER_WORKER:
643	            worker.steer_count += 1
644	            worker.last_steered_at = datetime.now(UTC)
645	
646	        if event.kind is HookEventKind.BEFORE_TOOL:
647	            if action in {InterventionType.ESCALATE, InterventionType.STOP_WORKER}:
648	                return HookOutcome(action=HookAction.BLOCK, reason=reason)
649	            if action is InterventionType.STEER_WORKER:
650	                return HookOutcome(action=HookAction.INJECT_CONTEXT, reason=reason)
651	            return HookOutcome()
652	
653	        if event.kind is HookEventKind.AFTER_TOOL:
654	            if action is InterventionType.ESCALATE:
655	                state.status = FactoryStatus.ESCALATED
656	                state.finished_at = datetime.now(UTC)
657	                return HookOutcome(
658	                    action=HookAction.HALT,
659	                    reason=reason,
660	                    system_message=reason,
661	                )
662	            if action is InterventionType.STOP_WORKER:
663	                worker.status = WorkerStatus.STOPPED
664	                worker.finished_at = datetime.now(UTC)
665	                state.active_workers = []
666	                return HookOutcome(action=HookAction.BLOCK, reason=reason)
667	            if action is InterventionType.STEER_WORKER:
668	                return HookOutcome(action=HookAction.INJECT_CONTEXT, reason=reason)
669	            return HookOutcome()
670	
671	        if event.kind is not HookEventKind.WORKER_STOPPING:
672	            return HookOutcome()
673	        if action is InterventionType.FINISH:
674	            state.status = FactoryStatus.FINISHED
675	            state.finished_at = datetime.now(UTC)
676	            return HookOutcome()
677	        if action is InterventionType.ESCALATE:
678	            state.status = FactoryStatus.ESCALATED
679	            state.finished_at = datetime.now(UTC)
680	            return HookOutcome(
681	                action=HookAction.HALT,
682	                reason=reason,
683	                system_message=reason,
684	            )
685	        if event.continuation_active:
686	            return HookOutcome(
687	                action=HookAction.HALT,
688	                reason=reason,
689	                system_message=(
690	                    "Foreman still found unfinished work after one automatic continuation: "
691	                    f"{reason}"
692	                ),
693	            )
694	        if action is InterventionType.START_VERIFIER:
695	            state.verification_started = True
696	        worker.status = WorkerStatus.RUNNING
697	        worker.finished_at = None
698	        state.active_workers = [worker.worker_id]
699	        state.completed_workers = []
700	        return HookOutcome(action=HookAction.BLOCK, reason=reason)

151	def _validate_route_groups(
152	    groups: tuple[RouteGroup, ...],
153	    candidates: ResponsibilityRegistry,
154	    *,
155	    max_depth: int = 8,
156	) -> set[str]:
157	    candidate_ids = {item.id for item in candidates.responsibilities}
158	    group_ids: set[str] = set()
159	    assigned: set[str] = set()
160	    visiting: set[int] = set()
161	
162	    def visit(group: RouteGroup, depth: int) -> None:
163	        if depth > max_depth:
164	            raise ResponsibilityRoutingError(
165	                f"routing hierarchy exceeds maximum depth of {max_depth}"
166	            )
167	        identity = id(group)
168	        if identity in visiting:
169	            raise ResponsibilityRoutingError(f"routing hierarchy contains a cycle at {group.id}")
170	        if group.id in group_ids:
171	            raise ResponsibilityRoutingError(f"duplicate routing group id: {group.id}")
172	        group_ids.add(group.id)
173	        visiting.add(identity)
174	        unknown = set(group.responsibility_ids) - candidate_ids
175	        if unknown:
176	            raise ResponsibilityRoutingError(
177	                f"routing group {group.id!r} references unknown responsibilities: "
178	                f"{', '.join(sorted(unknown))}"
179	            )
180	        duplicate_assignments = set(group.responsibility_ids) & assigned
181	        if duplicate_assignments:
182	            raise ResponsibilityRoutingError(
183	                "responsibilities may belong to only one routing group: "
184	                + ", ".join(sorted(duplicate_assignments))
185	            )
186	        assigned.update(group.responsibility_ids)
187	        for child in group.children:
188	            visit(child, depth + 1)
189	        visiting.remove(identity)
190	
191	    for root in groups:
192	        visit(root, 1)
193	    return assigned
